commands.command: Build a body-feedback observability audit that separates already-sliding detection from pre-limit future-envelope prediction.
commands.name: m146_body_feedback_probe

commands.command: Search for ambiguous body-only histories where command/actuator/ax/ay/yaw history is close but future envelope differs.
commands.name: m146_ambiguous_history_search

decision_rule: Do not start PPO from a new sensor profile until body-only history has been tested separately for post-slip detection, pre-limit envelope prediction, and ambiguity.
failure_criteria: probe uses slip ratio, v_parallel, tire force, mu, oracle labels, TTC, path error, or feasibility labels as actor-like inputs
pre-slip and post-slip samples are not separated
results come from a single seed only
ambiguous-history search is omitted before PPO admission
hypothesis: Continuous command, actuator, and ax/ay/yaw history may be enough to detect already-visible sliding but may be insufficient for pre-limit future-envelope prediction.
success_criteria: body-only H1 profile is defined with command, actuator, ax/ay/yaw, and scene history
post-slip detection and pre-limit future-envelope prediction are reported separately
at least three seeds are run
ambiguous body-history cases are exported or explicitly shown absent
no non-deployable actor inputs are introduced
